Inorganic arsenic is estimated from a linear regression on 13 published pairs from other countries. Table 3 prints a calculated mean of 63 µg/kg. That figure is not a measurement of these samples and is not a country-year row.

Table 2 prints rice arsenic means of 0.075 mg/kg at Savar, 0.031 mg/kg at Gazipur, and 0.048 mg/kg at Ashulia. Samples were collected from April to August 2021. The paper does not print one Bangladesh mean. The site means are not averaged.

The results text prints an average arsenic of 0.18 mg/kg fresh weight, with a printed figure of 0.18 plus or minus 0.003, and a range of 0.04 to 0.35 mg/kg fresh weight. Ten cultivars were purchased in Dhaka markets. The purchase year is not stated.
